home.eyebrow: A Summer Weekend in the Hudson Valley
home.welcome_text: A summer celebration surrounded by forest, open fields, old stone, warm barn lights, and the people we love most.
home.welcome_details: Thank you for making the trip to spend the weekend with us in the Hudson Valley. Everything you need—from the weekend schedule to travel details and RSVP information—is waiting here.

home.ceremony_text: Surrounded by trees. Gathered with everyone we love.
home.journey_intro: The day unfolds naturally—through the woods, across the lawn, beneath old timber, and into a night lit by string lights and a disco ball.
home.weekend_heading: More than a day. A whole weekend.

items.question: What is the dress code?
items.answer: The dress code is summer formal. Suits, dresses, jumpsuits, and polished separates are all appropriate. Because portions of the celebration may take place on grass or gravel, choose footwear accordingly.

items.question: Can I bring a plus-one?
items.answer: Please refer to your invitation and RSVP form. Only guests specifically named on the invitation are included.

items.question: Are children invited?
items.answer: We love your little ones, but unless they are specifically named on the invitation, this will be an adults-only celebration.

items.question: Will the ceremony be outside?
items.answer: The ceremony is planned outdoors, weather permitting. The venue has a rain plan, so the celebration will continue regardless of weather.

items.question: Will transportation be provided?
items.answer: We expect to provide transportation from selected hotel blocks. Exact pickup locations and times will be posted on the Travel page.

items.question: Is there parking at the venue?
items.answer: Yes. On-site parking information and any special instructions will be shared closer to the wedding.

items.question: When should I arrive?
items.answer: Please plan to arrive approximately 30 minutes before the ceremony so you have time to park, walk the grounds, and find your seat.

items.question: Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?
items.answer: Yes. Please include allergies or dietary restrictions in your RSVP so our catering team can plan accordingly.

items.question: Can I take photos during the ceremony?
items.answer: We kindly ask guests to keep phones and cameras away during the ceremony. You are welcome to take and share photos during cocktail hour and the reception.

items.question: Who should I contact with questions?
items.answer: Please contact [designated person] at [phone/email] for questions that are not answered on this website.
